facts.fact: The 2026 release calendar cites Statistics Act No 13 of 2018 as the law under which the Zambia Statistics Agency acts.
The Zambia Statistics Agency issued the National Statistical Release Calendar for 2026 on 2025-12-01, which the document says Section 27(1) of the Act requires it to prepare.
At the 2025-09-15 hub launch the Minister of Finance and National Planning cited Statistics Act No. 13 of 2018 as a policy framework the hub aligns with.

note: No act under the law is tied to it: the hub launch only aligns with the Act.

facts.fact: The Minister's foreword says the Census and Statistics Act of 1955 and the Agricultural Statistics Act of 1964 were repealed and replaced by Statistics Act No. 13 of 2018, which reconstituted the Central Statistics Office as the Zambia Statistics Agency.

The foreword says operationalisation of the Act has started with the appointment of the Board of Directors and the Statistician General and the establishment of a National Statistical Coordinating Committee of fifteen ministries; the document gives no date for these, so its July 2023 publication date is used.

note: The notice announces the appointment of a Statistician General but does not tie it to the Statistics Act, so no applied fact.

facts.fact: This document is the text of the Statistics Act, 2018 (Act No. 13 of 2018, assented 23 December 2018, enacted 26 December 2018), which repeals the Census and Statistics Act 1955 and the Agricultural Statistics Act 1964; its section 1 brings it into operation on a date the Minister appoints by statutory instrument.
A Zambia Statistics Agency representative says the agency's memorandum of understanding with ZICTA is guided by the Statistics Act No. 1 of 2017.

note: SPI 5.1.1 is a compliance score with no named law; states no fact.

facts.fact: ZamStats says it is a statutory body established through the Statistics Act No. 13 of 2018, mandated to compile and disseminate official statistics.
